title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does Before a Hard Conversation
caption:
Most hard conversations go wrong before anyone says a word. You walked in wanting to win.

A godly man does the work first. He prays before he plans his points. He deals with his own log. He goes to the man, not around him. And he owns his part before he names anyone else's.

Save this for the next talk you've been putting off.

#faith #godlyman #conflict #leadership
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
